records.title: Approve atomic all-or-nothing Storage Space batch-create contract
records.approvedDelta: One storage-spaces:batch-create request is one logical mutation intent and is atomic all-or-nothing. Validate the complete batch before commit; any mandatory failure rolls back every row and every business, audit, journal, idempotency and outbox effect. Exact-key/same-payload replay is safe; same-key/different-payload reuse conflicts. Partial success is prohibited.
records.rvmImpact: Register FD-75 and TA-D234 and map only the executed IMP-MD-005 atomic batch/idempotency/rollback verification.
records.testImpact: Complete success and rollback, no partial effects, exact replay, idempotency mismatch conflict and transaction fault rollback.

records.title: Adopt Supabase as the sole canonical core backend platform
records.approvedDelta: Supabase is the sole canonical backend platform for SiloMath application runtime. PostgreSQL remains the authoritative enterprise datastore. Server-authoritative business operations use Supabase PostgreSQL functions and/or Edge Functions. Android direct access is allowed only where explicitly permitted by API/security contract and RLS. Critical mutations remain server-authoritative, atomic and idempotent. No separate application backend/external compute service is canonical for core business operations; non-core auxiliary services cannot become authoritative for core business state without an approved Baseline Change.
records.rvmImpact: Register FD-76; preserve existing semantic verification and replace provider/topology evidence with Supabase Auth/PostgreSQL/RLS/Edge Functions/Storage evidence. Add proof that critical mutations cannot bypass approved server-authoritative paths and that core business state has no separate external-compute authority.
records.testImpact: Add Supabase Edge Function/API, PostgreSQL RPC/transaction, RLS, Auth/session, offline sync/idempotency/version, Storage integrity/security and environment promotion tests. Ktor/Render/JDBC-specific tests cease to be baseline acceptance evidence after migration closure.

records.title: Canonical Geometry Family display names
records.approvedDelta: Freeze exactly one canonical English GeometryFamily.displayName for each existing F01-F10 family: F01 Cylindrical Silo with Truncated Cone Hopper; F02 Cylindrical Silo with Flat Bottom; F03 Square Silo with Flat Bottom; F04 Rectangular Silo with Flat Bottom; F05 Square Silo with Pyramidal Hopper; F06 Rectangular Silo with Pyramidal Hopper; F07 Regular Hexagonal Silo with Flat Bottom; F08 Star-Shaped Storage with Verified Area; F09 Pocket Storage with Verified Area; F10 Perimeter-Based Storage with Verified Area. No formulaCode, formulaVersion, parameterContract or numerical semantics change.
records.rvmImpact: Add verification that exactly ten canonical Geometry Families exist and each familyCode maps to the approved displayName while calculation dispatch/version semantics remain unchanged.
records.testImpact: Add canonical seed assertions for all ten familyCode/displayName mappings, offline/read preservation checks, and regression proving displayName does not participate in numerical dispatch.

records.title: Platform governance provenance actor for global master-data publication
records.approvedDelta: Freeze PLATFORM_GOVERNANCE_ACTOR_ID as 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001 for explicitly platform-governed master-data publication where the persistence contract requires a UUID provenance/creator value and no authenticated-user FK is required. The identity is non-user, non-tenant, non-authenticating and must not grant authorization. The canonical Commodity and CommodityVersion seed is an approved use.
records.rvmImpact: Add verification that canonical platform-governed Commodity and CommodityVersion rows use the frozen provenance actor and that the reserved UUID has no user, membership, tenant or authorization effect.
records.testImpact: Add seed provenance assertions, schema regression confirming no users FK is required for the approved columns, and security regression ensuring the reserved UUID cannot act as an authorization principal.

records.title: Eliminate legacy runtime and backwards-compatibility support
records.approvedDelta: SiloMath Android supports only the current approved V6 runtime and current local schema. Historical Android/Room compatibility, legacy local runtime models, Long-to-UUID shims, legacy_* fields and historical Room upgrade paths may be removed. Fresh installation creates the current canonical V6 schema directly. PostgreSQL/Supabase migration history required by the current canonical backend remains preserved.
records.rvmImpact: Remove verification whose sole purpose is unsupported historical Android schema upgrade compatibility; retain current V6 functional, offline, persistence and synchronization verification.
records.testImpact: Replace historical Room migration regression coverage with current canonical V6 schema creation, persistence, offline and synchronization coverage.
